notes: Selectable optional third-party installs with repo-aware suggestions. Global install only — no project scope.

installRules.guidance: Do not install multiple overlapping packs for the same purpose unless the user explicitly asks.

overlapCaps.note: One primary everyday code-quality/minimalism pack (e.g. Ponytail or Simplify)
Prefer selected SEO skills; full pack only on request
ECC minimal by default; avoid stacking with plugin install
Framework-specific specialists may complement generic audit/performance skills
One heavy adversarial/independent assurance pack for high-risk changes

presets.name: Lean Daily Coding
presets.description: Impeccable + Ponytail — default UI quality plus YAGNI/minimalism.

presets.name: Core Next.js Lite
presets.description: Lean daily coding + Vercel React Best Practices for React/Next.js.

presets.name: Core Next.js Full-Stack
presets.description: core-next-lite + Graphify for medium/large Next.js repos.

presets.name: Core Next.js Agentic
presets.description: core-next + durable constraints + ECC minimal (manual install).

presets.name: Growth + SEO/GEO
presets.description: core-next + selected SEO/GEO skills (not the full 20-skill suite).

presets.name: Audit / Review
presets.description: Broad audit + architecture survey + adversarial assurance for substantial reviews.

presets.name: Experimental Heavy
presets.description: Large experimental install — high bloat, explicit opt-in only.

packs.name: Impeccable

suggestiveTest.question: Does this project have a user-facing UI?

packs.description: Design language for agent harnesses — UI/UX quality, anti-slop patterns, frontend polish workflows.
packs.warning: The upstream skills CLI may report partial failures for unsupported harnesses (e.g. PromptScript). If Verify is OK, Impeccable is installed for supported agents.

global.summary: User-wide skill (Claude/Cursor agents paths via skills CLI)

packs.name: Simplify
avoidWhen: Ponytail is already the primary review pack
native kenmark-issues-scan simplify mode is sufficient

suggestiveTest.question: Will agents write or refactor code in this repo?

packs.description: Simplify and refine recently modified code for clarity and consistency — use after generating or editing code without changing functionality.

global.summary: User-wide simplify skill (Claude/Cursor agents paths via skills CLI)

alternatives: Manual: copy skills/simplify/SKILL.md from brianlovin/claude-config into ~/.claude/skills/simplify/

packs.name: Ponytail
avoidWhen: you need plugin hooks without separate Claude/Codex setup

suggestiveTest.question: Do agents here tend to over-engineer or write more code than needed?

packs.description: YAGNI-first coding discipline for agents — a six-rung ladder (skip, stdlib, platform, deps, one line, then minimum) plus review, audit, and debt skills. Lazy, not negligent: security, accessibility, and validation stay intact.
packs.warning: Installs 5 skills via npx. Overlaps with Simplify (review category) — pick one primary unless you want both. For always-on rules and Claude/Codex lifecycle hooks, install the plugin: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail then /plugin install ponytail@ponytail. Cursor/Windsurf: copy rules from the repo. Node.js on PATH for plugin hooks.

global.summary: User-wide ponytail pack (5 skills via skills CLI)

alternatives: Claude plugin: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail then /plugin install ponytail@ponytail
Codex: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail
Cursor: copy .cursor/rules/ from the repo into ~/.cursor/rules/

packs.name: improve
bestFor: capable model audits + cheaper model execution
security, perf, and tech-debt findings with evidence
avoidWhen: teams that do not want a plans/ directory

suggestiveTest.question: Would a structured audit → plan → execute workflow help this repo?

packs.description: Audit any codebase and write self-contained implementation plans for other agents to execute — expensive model advises, cheaper models ship. Never modifies source; writes only to plans/ and uses isolated worktrees for execute.
packs.warning: Writes plans to repo-root plans/ (not brain/plans/). Complements but differs from kenmark-plan. The skill never edits application source — only plans/ and disposable executor worktrees.

global.summary: User-wide improve skill (Claude/Cursor agents paths via skills CLI)

alternatives: Claude plugin: /plugin marketplace add shadcn/improve then /plugin install improve

packs.name: Vercel React Best Practices
bestFor: Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects

suggestiveTest.question: Does this repo use React or Next.js?

packs.description: Vercel Engineering's React/Next.js performance skill — prioritized rules for waterfalls, bundle loading, server/client boundaries, rendering, data fetching, and re-renders.
packs.warning: Framework-specific specialist. Pair with kenmark-performance for broader DB/API/runtime analysis; do not treat it as a replacement for generic performance review.

global.summary: Install Vercel React Best Practices globally

alternatives: Manual: install only skills/react-best-practices from vercel-labs/agent-skills

packs.name: Improve Codebase Architecture
avoidWhen: repos where architecture work is out of scope

suggestiveTest.question: Is this repo large or change-heavy enough to benefit from architecture review?

packs.description: Surveys codebases for shallow modules and architectural friction, then proposes deeper interfaces/seams that improve testability and maintainability.
packs.warning: The architecture skill relies on Matt Pocock's codebase-design vocabulary; this pack installs both codebase-design and improve-codebase-architecture. It may create architecture reports/issues depending on the upstream workflow.

global.command: npx --yes skills add https://github.com/mattpocock/skills -g -y -s codebase-design && npx --yes skills add https://github.com/mattpocock/skills -g -y -s improve-codebase-architecture

alternatives: Interactive: npx skills add https://github.com/mattpocock/skills and select codebase-design + improve-codebase-architecture

packs.name: Constraint-Driven Development
bestFor: teams that want explicit quality floors
avoidWhen: repos where root-level CONSTRAINTS.md is unwanted

suggestiveTest.question: Would persistent measurable quality constraints help keep agent changes within bounds?

packs.description: Defines a durable quality bar in CONSTRAINTS.md, places checks by cost, and catches attempts to silence checks or skip tests just to get green.
packs.warning: Writes/maintains a repo-root CONSTRAINTS.md when invoked. Treat constraints as reviewed project policy; do not weaken them merely to make a change pass.

alternatives: Browse first: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --list

packs.name: Adverse Review
avoidWhen: harnesses without subagent support unless using the CLI

suggestiveTest.question: Does this repo regularly ship large or high-risk changes that benefit from adversarial review?

packs.description: Multi-agent adversarial review: independent reviewers, cross-examination, and deterministic synthesis to reduce single-reviewer blind spots.
packs.warning: Heavy review path. Skill mode expects subagent support; the standalone adverse CLI requires Node.js 20+. Use for important changes rather than every small commit.

packs.name: Graphify

suggestiveTest.question: Is this repo large enough to benefit from a knowledge graph?

packs.description: Turns code, schemas, docs, and media into a queryable knowledge graph for project navigation.
packs.warning: Python-based (graphifyy on PyPI). Requires uv, pipx, or pip.

global.command: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install
global.summary: Install graphifyy via uv, then register the skill with global agents

packs.name: SEO & GEO (selected skills)

suggestiveTest.question: Is this a public marketing or content site?

packs.description: Six high-value SEO/GEO skills (keyword research, technical audit, schema, on-page, content, GEO) — not the full 20-skill suite. Install verify for all defaultSeoSkills is built at runtime; catalog verify is a single-skill sample.
packs.warning: Installs selected skills only. For all 20 skills use seo-geo-full.

global.summary: Full pack command (use batch selected-skills install at runtime)
Install selected SEO/GEO skills globally in one run

packs.name: SEO & GEO (full pack)

suggestiveTest.question: Do you need the entire 20-skill SEO/GEO suite?

packs.description: All 20 SEO and GEO skills plus slash commands — high bloat; prefer seo-geo-selected for most sites.
packs.warning: Full pack installs 20 skills + 20 slash commands. Explicit opt-in only.

packs.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)

suggestiveTest.question: Do you want a large agent harness overlay?

packs.description: Agent-harness performance system — skills, agents, hooks, rules. Manual install until npm installer is verified.
packs.warning: ECC npm installer is not verified. Kenmark prints manual/plugin steps. Do not stack with plugin install.

profiles.description: Minimal: rules, agents, commands, core workflow skills (~3-5 agents, ~10-15 skills).
Core: standard install. Pair with --without baseline:hooks to keep hooks off
Full: complete installer (28 agents, 119 skills). Explicit opt-in only

global.summary: Install ECC with the selected profile into global Claude config

alternatives: Plugin: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC && /plugin install ecc@ecc

packs.name: draw.io Diagrams

suggestiveTest.question: Would agents create architecture, flow, or UML diagrams in this repo?

packs.description: Generate draw.io diagrams from natural language — architecture, UML, ERD, flowcharts, ML layouts; vision self-check, codebase-to-diagram, 10k+ official shapes; exports PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG.
packs.warning: Requires draw.io desktop CLI (`brew install --cask drawio` on macOS). Optional Graphviz for auto-layout of large import graphs. The upstream skills CLI may report partial failures for unsupported harnesses (e.g. PromptScript). If verify is OK, drawio-skill is installed for supported agents.

global.summary: User-wide drawio-skill (Claude/Cursor agents paths via skills CLI)

alternatives: Claude plugin: /plugin marketplace add Agents365-ai/365-skills then /plugin install drawio
